subject: Request Entity too large error while using the fileInput function

messages.author: dcc66b8e613dc173
messages.subject: Request Entity too large error while using the fileInput function
parts:
My app is taking as input text files that contain two columns delimited by tab. When the files do not exceed 500 kB, everything works fine. But when I try to upload a 2 Mb file, the app returns an error. The file upload stops, and inside the progress bar I see "<table><head><title> 413 Request entity too large ..."

here is the code: 

ui side: 

    fileInput("SpecFile", "1: Choose the spectrum file", multiple = FALSE,
              accept = NULL),
    numericInput("skipLines","Skip first n lines:",6),
    
    checkboxInput("Header","Header?",TRUE),


server side:

    GetRawSpectrum <- reactive({
  
    inFile <- input$SpecFile
    read.table(inFile$datapath, header = input$Header, skip = input$skipLines)
    
  })

Could anyone comment on that?

messages.author: e84e7628b5f8a3e1
messages.subject: Re: [shinyapps-users] Request Entity too large error while using the fileInput function
parts:
Hi,

This is a known limitation of ShinyApps. Currently file uploads are limited to 1MB. We have this on our backlog to increase the limit to 10MB.

Thanks!

-Andy
